deep_analysis:
TRADE WATCHDOG — WARNING (agent cycle 2026-10-23 ~11:17 UTC)

Open: 1 (0 long, 1 short) — CC SHORT #16363, open 18m, entry 0.10241, flat
(-0.01%). Unrealized ~0.00. 24h realized +0.29 / 11 closes (7W); pipeline
status: 11 closed today, +9.28%. Enforced checks: regime alignment PASS
(CC short vs BTC below EMA300 219m, LEAN_BEAR/STRONG_DOWN); breakeven/trail
triggers N/A (CC MFE only +0.24%, never reached +0.40% arm); no trade open
8h+; exposure 1 short / 0 long = aligned with the only book that pays.

The CC short is fading. Since entry it has printed 3 ascending 5m closes
(0.10218 → 0.10232 → 0.10236 → 0.10242), the last one 1 tick ABOVE entry,
and its max favorable excursion was +0.24% — short of the +0.40% needed to
arm the trail. The coin itself is NEUTRAL/is_ranging (regime_5m 11:15: conf
50.7, slope -0.019%, -0.27% over 16 candles) — this was a drift entry into
chop, and chop is where hard_max_loss (19T/0W, 19/20 LONG) and
trail_arm_timeout (10T/2W -0.45) live. The trail family never qualified, so
right now the trade has no upside mechanism: either momentum shows up and
arms it, or we are simply waiting to give back. Management is condition-
worded below, not an exit order.

Portfolio: nothing is broken and nothing is at risk of a giveback rule yet
(no trade +2% or more). The real standing risk is the queue — 8 pending
shorts + 2 approved (ENS, BIGTIME) against 5 free slots of
MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS=6, with BTC sitting 0.16% under EMA300 in a tape that
changes direction state ~every hour (25 aggregate flips/24h). Five correlated
shorts loaded at once turns a single EMA300 reclaim into one shared loss.

Patterns (fresh, this cycle): the long book is still the bleed — 7d LONG
105T/37% -3.10 vs SHORT 35T/40% +0.11; today 24h LONG 40% vs SHORT 83%.
Every worst signal/direction pair n>=5 is a LONG (pump-chain+ 14T/1W -1.21,
bb-bounce-v2-long+ 20T/9W -0.62, ai-trader+ 10T/4W -0.51). The winning side
on all of them is the short leg or no trade — BTC has been below EMA300
since ~09:26. We are not repeating a new mistake; we are still carrying the
old one in the pending queue (1 LONG among 9 pendings) and in
steer-001's signal family.

No direction-flavored steer issued beyond conditions: sources disagree this
cycle (regime_5m aggregate SHORT_BIAS 42S/10L vs watchdog btc_15m LONG_BIAS
vs btc_4h SHORT_BIAS vs regime_5m BTC NEUTRAL), and at 25 flips/24h a
snapshot direction does not survive to the next cycle.

Prior-cycle resolution: the LTC #16362 hold steer is RESOLVED as a WIN —
profit-monster-trail closed 11:09 at 58.910, +4.08% (+0.09 USDT). Superseded
by CC management. The stale-BTC 12:44 cut remains moot (trade closed via
UNIVERSAL_MAX_HOLD at 10:45). Old queue skip-advice (BTC LONG / SEI SHORT /
WLFI LONG) has expired naturally — none of those three is in the current
queue. No retraction owed this cycle.

AI trader: no pick this cycle — SYRUP LONG written 10:48:57 is 28.7 min old
(< 45 min window), and AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False in hermes_constants.py, so any
pick is watchlist-only regardless.
